## Load data
```{r}

folder_list <- list.files("data/valid/nowildfire")

# Get file name
file_name <- map("data/valid/nowildfire", 
                 function(x) paste0(x, list.files(x))
                 ) %>% 
  unlist()

# first 6 file name
head(file_name)

length(file_name)

```
## Preview data

```{r}
install.packages("dylib")
install.packages("imager")
library(imager)

# Randomly select image
set.seed(99)
random_img <- sample(file_name, 6)

# Load image into R
img <- map(random_img, load.image)

# Plot image
par(mfrow = c(2, 3)) # 2x3 image grid
map(img, plot)


```
